Workflow.Name: DealOS | Trade desk
Workflow.Description: A received email's triage becomes Genuine (by Mail Triage or a person) → Trade Desk agent: records requirement / quote / price, sources sellers, opens confirm tasks, drafts the replies. Failures → Deal Manager task.
